name: CoreRender library
description: Shared render module (Sources/CoreRender): the RenderBackend contract every app's Model draws through, its backends (a fake for tests, and the CPU backend over CoreRaster as it lands), the routing of each op to a backend as it lands, the parity harness, and the Linux-safe parts of the Metal backend (capabilities, tiling math, cache keys). Linux-safe, Foundation only.

relationships.description: backends hold surfaces as CoreRaster pixel buffers and the parity harness compares them; the CPU backend, as it lands, draws through CoreRaster's operations
display encodes into CoreColor's color spaces
